name: PTR character copy: a two-word name over 12 letters is copied once
contract: Character names may have a second word, up to MAX_PLAYER_NAME (25) letters. .ptr copy reads the whole name after the command, and coa_ptr_copy_request stores source and copy names of that length, so the request is queued under its full name, the copy (renamed with its GUID in hex because ptr_character_copy makes this realm both source and target) loads once, and the source realm reports it.

steps.label: The source account starts with one character
Copy the online character by its full two-word name
DISCRIMINATING: the copy is queued under the full name
steps.text: Harness Longcopy is on its way to

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the queued copy loads as a second character
The request completes, so the source realm reports the copy
Let the target realm poll the request table three more times
The completed request is not loaded again
